lead: `Core\Config::restore` in a `.nvst` case can end it with a `FATAL`: the ceiling drops while the raised allowance is live.
body: A case that raises its `[limits]` ceiling, allocates and restores breaches at the next helper call; drop the ballast before restoring, since a request cannot un-allocate by lowering its own limit. A case may carry `--EXPECT--` and `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` together, so both the stdout before a `FATAL` and the `FATAL` line are pinnable.
